meta.name: multi-reviewer-patterns
meta.description: Coordinate parallel code reviews across multiple quality dimensions with finding deduplication, severity calibration, and consolidated reporting. Use this skill when organizing multi-reviewer code reviews, calibrating finding severity, or consolidating review results.

copy.tagline: 协调多路并行代码审查，去重并汇总结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常组织多人代码审查并需统一汇总反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate parallel code reviews, deduplicate findings, and consolidate results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often organize code review with multiple reviewers and need consolidated feedback.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能把一次代码审查拆成安全、性能、架构等多个维度并行推进，合并不同审查者指向同一位置的相同发现，冲突的严重性自动取更高值，最后生成按严重级分类的汇总报告。
howto.when: 当用户要组织多位审查者的代码审查、校准发现严重性，或合并审查结果时触发。

say.text: 用安全、性能、架构三个维度审查这段代码，合并同一位置的重复发现。
say.note: 会拆分维度并行审，并去重。

say.text: 把多份审查报告合并，重复发现只留一条，冲突的严重级别取更高值。
把这批发现按严重性分级，汇总成带统计表的报告。

howto.what_en: Claude can run parallel code reviews across multiple quality dimensions, merge duplicate findings at the same location, apply the higher severity when ratings conflict, and produce a consolidated report grouped by severity.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to organize multi-reviewer code reviews, calibrate finding severity, or consolidate review results.

say_en.text: Review this code across security, performance, architecture; dedupe findings.
Merge findings from reports; keep unique, take higher severity.
Group findings by severity into a summary report.
